summary: The EDA Event Stream API (POST to /api/eda-event-stream) is a separate Gunicorn service for importing external events; when it shows high latency, low throughput or gateway 503s, scale the eda-event-stream deployment on OpenShift or add hybrid nodes on VM and container installs.
questions: How do I scale EDA event streams?
Why does the EDA event stream return 503?
